answer: Registration is metered by a tradable seat token: each established identity accrues one seat per epoch, and a candidate registers only by burning a seat bought at a dutch auction starting at 0.05 POA, decaying to a 0.01 floor. A farm of 50 clones pays that clearing price, about 1.5-3 POA plus 50 settlements, and each clone must also carry a distinct velvet persona tag and tundra node fingerprint so seats cannot collapse into one wallet. Idle seats earn nothing, so a glacier of unsold supply damps spikes. Failure mode: clearing at the floor two epochs running makes farming profitable.
